title: Berglsteiner See Breitenbach
highlights: Mystical forest lake nestled in the Berglstein protected landscape area
Educational nature trail highlighting native flora, fauna, and local lore
Popular natural bathing lake offering tranquil secluded spots among the trees
Traditional Berglsteiner See restaurant with sunny waterside terrace
kurzbeschreibung: Berglsteiner See between Breitenbach and Kramsach is an enchanted natural lake surrounded by mythical scenery.
beschreibung:
Legendary Forest Lake

The Berglsteiner See lies hidden on a wooded ridge at an altitude of 713 meters between Kramsach and Breitenbach am Inn. Old Tyrolean folk legends of a sunken castle and tragic love entwine the lake, adding a distinctive charm to the wildly romantic scenery.

Nature Trail and Swimming Pleasure

An informative nature educational trail leads around the lake, providing insights into the protected flora and fauna of the Berglstein. In summer, the lake is popular with swimmers who appreciate its calm, shady atmosphere far away from the crowds. The welcoming lakeside restaurant treats guests to hearty Tyrolean delicacies.
